official_contact_or_quote_link: https://www.mydhl.com · quote via DHL Express MyDHL / account manager
origin_pickup_coverage: Supplier-arranged pickup to DHL origin facility (must be booked)
customs_brokerage: Customs clearance via DHL Express / DHL Global Forwarding; confirm whether duty/tax is prepaid or collect
food_organic_acceptance_questions: Ask: perishable/food acceptance, temperature not required for dry spices, organic paperwork acceptance, country-specific food import rules
required_shipment_info: Commercial invoice, packing list, HS code, Incoterm + named place, declared value, organic/transaction certificate, phytosanitary if required
published_transit_indication: DHL states international express typically 1–3 business days transit; customs clearance usually on arrival but can add several days if flagged
cost_coverage: Origin pickup/export charges + main transport + insurance + clearance + destination handling + delivery — itemise each
suitability_small_initial_order: Reasonable for a small, high-value, time-critical parcel
recommended_next_quote_request: Quote door-to-door delivered cost incl. duties for the exact origin and destination ZIP
notes: Do not treat airport transit as the delivered date

customs_brokerage: FedEx International Priority is customs-cleared; confirm duty/tax payment terms
food_organic_acceptance_questions: Ask: food/agri acceptance, dry-spice commodity, organic documents, any restricted-food rules by destination
required_shipment_info: Commercial invoice, packing list, HS code, Incoterm + named place, declared value, organic certificate
published_transit_indication: FedEx states International Priority delivers in 1–3 business days to many destinations
cost_coverage: Same itemisation as above — origin pickup, transport, insurance, clearance, destination handling, delivery
recommended_next_quote_request: Quote delivered cost for exact origin + destination ZIP, and confirm duties prepaid vs collect
notes: Express transit is door-to-door and customs-cleared, but clearance delays can still apply

customs_brokerage: UPS customs brokerage available; confirm duty/tax terms
food_organic_acceptance_questions: Ask: food/agri acceptance, dry commodity, organic paperwork, import restrictions
required_shipment_info: Commercial invoice, packing list, HS code, Incoterm + named place, declared value, organic certificate
published_transit_indication: UPS states Worldwide Expedited delivers in 2–5 business days; Saver typically 1–3 business days
recommended_next_quote_request: Quote delivered cost for exact lanes
notes: Expedited is day-definite; Saver is typically faster/cheaper — confirm which service is quoted

official_contact_or_quote_link: https://www.mhl-dgf.com · request an international freight quote
door_to_door_vs_terminal: Can be door-to-door or airport-to-airport — CONFIRM
customs_brokerage: Forwarder-managed clearance can be quoted; confirm inclusions
food_organic_acceptance_questions: Ask: food/dry-commodity acceptance, organic docs, DG-free status for dry powder
required_shipment_info: Cargo details: cartons, weight, dimensions, commodity description, HS code, origin/destination, declared value, Incoterm
published_transit_indication: DHL states it provides immediate air-freight quotation for general cargo up to ~2,000 kg per shipment; transit QUOTE REQUIRED
cost_coverage: Origin handling + freight + clearance + destination + delivery — itemise; watch minimum charges and airport terminal fees
suitability_small_initial_order: Possible for consolidation; overhead may exceed value on a small order
recommended_next_quote_request: Request a delivered quote and ask explicitly what is excluded
notes: Airport-to-airport pricing must not be compared with a delivered quote without adding remaining charges

option: D — Ocean LCL (only if size/timeline justify)
origin_pickup_coverage: Consolidation required — not viable for one small parcel
door_to_door_vs_terminal: Terminal-to-terminal more common; door delivery an extra service
food_organic_acceptance_questions: Ask: dry-commodity acceptance, food import requirements
required_shipment_info: Cargo + cartons + weight/volume + HS code + ports + Incoterm
published_transit_indication: DHL cites 2,800+ weekly LCL services; transit QUOTE REQUIRED
actual_delivery_estimate: NOT SUITABLE for a small time-critical launch order — LONGER-TERM OPTION
cost_coverage: Origin CFS + ocean + destination CFS + clearance + delivery + demurrage risk — itemise
recommended_next_quote_request: Do not request for the first shipment; revisit at scale
notes: LCL consolidation and demurrage make this unsuitable for a small launch order

company_or_service: Supplier's own forwarder / EXW or FCA terms
transport_mode: Supplier's choice — often sea or air
customs_brokerage: Supplier's broker or buyer's — depends on terms
food_organic_acceptance_questions: Ask the supplier who arranges and who holds documents
required_shipment_info: Supplier handles; buyer must still receive documents for import
cost_coverage: Often quoted FOB/CIF only — does NOT include destination charges
suitability_small_initial_order: Poor unless supplier holds a strong delivered rate
recommended_next_quote_request: Ask each supplier for a delivered (DAP/DDP) quote to the US packer ZIP
notes: FOB/CIF quotes exclude destination charges — do not compare with delivered quotes

option: E — Domestic parcel or LTL, supplier → packer
published_transit_indication: Carrier published transit (1–5 business days typical)
suitability_small_initial_order: GOOD — likely the simplest completed route
notes: Cheapest when the first shipment is domestic

company_or_service: Packer-arranged to FBA, or Amazon Partner Carrier
official_contact_or_quote_link: Via packer, or Amazon Partner Carrier options where eligible
cost_coverage: Inbound transportation + placement fees are SEPARATE Amazon charges
notes: Domestic packer-to-Amazon leg; quote after FBA destination is fixed

cost_coverage: Partner-carrier pricing plus Amazon inbound placement fees
suitability_small_initial_order: Depends on eligibility and shipment size
recommended_next_quote_request: Confirm eligibility in Seller Central before relying on it
notes: Partner-carrier pricing is separate from Amazon inbound placement fees

cost_coverage: Use to COMPARE quotes; the actual performing carrier must be identified per quote
recommended_next_quote_request: Use to compare; then confirm the performing carrier and what the price includes
notes: Do not treat the platform as the carrier performing pickup
